title: chore(deps): bump @objectstack/spec & client to ^7.6.0
body:
## Summary
Upgrade all `@objectstack/*` dependencies to the latest **7.6.0** across the monorepo.

- `@objectstack/spec`: `^7.2.1` / `^7.3.0` → `^7.6.0`
- `@objectstack/client`: `^7.2.1` → `^7.6.0`

Touches 11 `package.json` files (root, `apps/console`, `apps/site`, and 8 `packages/*`) plus `pnpm-lock.yaml`.

## Verification
- `pnpm install` clean; lockfile resolves all to `7.6.0`.
- `type-check` passes for every consumer: types, core, app-shell, data-objectstack, react, console, plugin-gantt, plugin-map, plugin-timeline. No breaking changes.
